snippet.title: Edenfall: Legacy of the First Wardens - Demo Trailer  | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
Dive into the mystical realm of Edenfall and awaken your true power. As Venya, a young shapeshifter guided by the fox-spirit Alkina, you’ll explore a land overgrown by corruption and fight to restore its lost beauty. Shift seamlessly between human, wolf, raccoon and raven forms. Each form unlocks unique traversal and combat abilities. Weave fluid combos across different forms, restore corrupted areas and uncover the secrets of the First Wardens. Your journey begins when the light within you awakens.

Wishlist now on Steam to receive updates and be ready for launch.

#Edenfall #LegacyOfTheFirstWardens #IndieActionAdventure #ShapeShifterGame
